payload.reason: PR #834 exact head 507e35d7478515d17afe86a88b4b5d3de9c87f45 has two confirmed P2 review defects despite 6/6 green CI. P2-1: WorkshopGateEvidenceExport is fed workspace.originalSnapshot versus final staged snapshot, but originalSnapshot predates any certified/local reuse staged before Engineer. The export can therefore include unrelated pre-Engineer reuse, misstate its repository content as the rejected proposal baseline, contaminate evidence across phases, and consume the clipboard limit before the actual rejected Engineer diff. The evidence must use the exact pre-Engineer/revision baseline and restrict paths to the rejected proposal actually judged. P2-2: Reviewer compact-first selects compact when the full prompt exceeds 7000 chars but never measures the resulting compact prompt before inference. Long instruction/constraints/targetFiles/coverage can leave compact above the same threshold and reproduce the zero-token failure. Build and measure compact before submission, then reduce/split within existing batch/coverage semantics or fail closed; do not add retry/token/timeout/model budget. No evidence classifies the historical star.dart finding yet.
